purpose: Historical China comparator evidence for Shanghai 2007 versus KOSPI 2026; descriptive research only.
unit_policy: Every original numeric unit is explicit. Growth, return and share percentages normalize by /100; per mille by /1000; percentage-point changes by /100 to fraction-point changes. These rates are not forecast probabilities. No magnitude-based unit inference, clipping or normalization to force validity.

claims.conclusion: Strong export/profit boom is established; a uniquely first-place country beneficiary and direct listed-index exposure are not established.
No matched global country-index EPS growth ranking or contemporary forecast vintage is available in this China evidence pack.
Heavy natural-person turnover, positive annual net purchases and very rapid account growth; not literal universal participation.
Market development reform coexisted with tightening, tax increases and risk warnings. No evidence here of an unconditional household-buying directive.
Two selected episodes cannot establish a predictive crash probability or causal correlation. Prospective matched-universe analysis and counterexamples are required.

observations.statement: 2007-10-16 intraday highs differ between SSE Composite and SSE A Share; the attachment's approximately 6429 level is consistent with A Share, conditional on chart identity verification.
observations.source_locator: PDF page 19 (1-based), printed page 7, Data of SSE Index Series 2007
observations.availability_note: Exact original public availability timestamp is not established. Publication date is separate metadata, not an intraday availability timestamp.
observations.interpretation_caveat: Intraday highs are not daily closes. Do not compare Composite peak 6124 with A Share level 6429 or treat chart annotations as an independently authenticated series.

observations.statement: SSE Composite 2007 annual price return was 96.66%; A Share was 96.14%.
observations.source_locator: PDF page 19 (1-based), printed page 7
observations.availability_note: Exact original public availability timestamp is not established. Publication date is separate metadata, not an intraday availability timestamp.
observations.interpretation_caveat: Price returns exclude dividends and currency translation.

observations.statement: 2008 annual price returns were -65.39% for Composite and -65.38% for A Share.
observations.source_locator: PDF page 13 (1-based), printed page 7
observations.availability_note: Exact original public availability timestamp is not established. Publication date is separate metadata, not an intraday availability timestamp.
observations.interpretation_caveat: This outcome is hindsight and cannot be used to select an ex ante 2007 warning rule or as a Korea forecast probability.

observations.statement: The historical SSE definition uses stock price divided by prior-year after-tax EPS; aggregate PE is sum(close*issued shares)/sum(EPS*issued shares).
observations.source_locator: PDF page 5 (1-based), printed page 1, definitions 14 and 17; visually checked in qa/pe_definition_2008.png
observations.availability_note: Exact original public availability timestamp is not established. Publication date is separate metadata, not an intraday availability timestamp.
observations.interpretation_caveat: A lagged annual earnings denominator, not TTM or forward consensus. Published loss-company treatment and revision schedules have not been separately established. Average PE is not the arithmetic mean of constituent PE values.

observations.statement: Year-end SSE average PE rose materially from 2005 through 2007.
observations.source_locator: PDF page 16 (1-based), printed page 4, Overview / Average P/E Ratio
observations.availability_note: Exact original public availability timestamp is not established. Publication date is separate metadata, not an intraday availability timestamp.
observations.interpretation_caveat: 2007 year-end PE follows the October peak. Denominators, index membership, issuance, accounting changes and valuation date must match before any earnings/valuation decomposition.

observations.statement: The boom also coincided with sharply higher A-share capital raising and a large difference between issued and negotiable capitalization.
observations.source_locator: PDF page 15 (1-based), printed page 3, Overview / Capital Raised and Market Capitalization
observations.availability_note: Exact original public availability timestamp is not established. Publication date is separate metadata, not an intraday availability timestamp.
observations.interpretation_caveat: Capital raised is not labeled IPO-only and should not be described as such. Total issued and negotiable capitalization are different universes. Supply changes and listing composition confound a simple earnings-versus-PE return attribution.

observations.statement: The exchange reports different 2007 price returns across its legacy sector indices.
observations.source_locator: PDF page 19 (1-based), printed page 7, Data of SSE Index Series 2007
observations.availability_note: Exact original public availability timestamp is not established. Publication date is separate metadata, not an intraday availability timestamp.
observations.interpretation_caveat: These are sector-index price returns, not sector contributions to Composite or A Share returns. Legacy sector definitions and contemporaneous weights need separate reconciliation.

observations.statement: In the SSE's 2007 share-investor table, natural persons had 86.01% trading share and a positive net purchase balance.
observations.source_locator: PDF page 352 (1-based), printed page 340, Balance of Investors in 2007
observations.availability_note: Exact original public availability timestamp is not established. Publication date is separate metadata, not an intraday availability timestamp.
observations.interpretation_caveat: Do not generalize this share-investor table to all securities such as bond/repo trades. Annual exchange-level net balance is not household new cash contributed or continuous daily buying. Source rounding means investor-category balances need not sum exactly to zero.

observations.statement: Natural-person new A-share accounts rose sharply; accounts are not a national unique-investor headcount.
observations.source_locator: PDF pages 349-350 (1-based), printed pages 337-338, Historical Data of Shareholder's Accounts
observations.availability_note: Exact original public availability timestamp is not established. Publication date is separate metadata, not an intraday availability timestamp.
observations.interpretation_caveat: This SSE-only A-share count must not be mixed with CSRC combined-exchange or SSE fund-inclusive account counts. Account activity, dormant-account treatment and unique-person coverage differ.

observations.statement: Natural persons held 48.29% of the year-end shareholding market value reported in the investor table, while their trading share was substantially higher.
observations.source_locator: PDF page 352 (1-based), printed page 340, Share Hold of Investors by 2007
observations.availability_note: Exact original public availability timestamp is not established. Publication date is separate metadata, not an intraday availability timestamp.
observations.interpretation_caveat: Investor table's holdings universe differs from total issued capitalization. Do not equate 48.29% with natural persons owning that share of all Chinese corporate equity.

observations.statement: The monthly 2007 account-opening table reports cumulative year-to-date additions, not additions during each month.
observations.source_locator: PDF page 353 (1-based), printed page 341, Open Account of Investor
observations.availability_note: Exact original public availability timestamp is not established. Publication date is separate metadata, not an intraday availability timestamp.
observations.interpretation_caveat: December value equals the stated annual total; summing monthly rows would double count. Original rows include all A-share accounts, whereas the natural-person annual table excludes institutions.

observations.statement: 20.23 million dormant accounts were segregated on October 8, 2007 under the account-standardization process.
observations.source_locator: Article body, account segregation effective October 8
observations.availability_note: Exact original public availability timestamp is not established. Publication date is separate metadata, not an intraday availability timestamp.
observations.interpretation_caveat: Account cleaning creates a potential measurement break in active/total account series; this is not equivalent to investors withdrawing on that day.

observations.statement: CSRC acknowledged rapid entry by inexperienced small investors and explicitly emphasized risk education and cautious participation.
observations.source_locator: Interview on October 17, article published October 18; section on current priority of investor risk education
observations.availability_note: Exact original public availability timestamp is not established. Publication date is separate metadata, not an intraday availability timestamp.
observations.interpretation_caveat: Published two days after the October 16 peak, so this particular article is not a pre-peak warning observation. Earlier risk education is described but primary publication timestamps must be established separately.

observations.statement: Year-end 2007 A-share capitalization was concentrated in energy, banks and insurers rather than a pure export-manufacturing basket.
observations.source_locator: PDF page 77 (1-based), printed page 65, Top 10 A Shares by Market Capitalization
observations.availability_note: Exact original public availability timestamp is not established. Publication date is separate metadata, not an intraday availability timestamp.
observations.interpretation_caveat: These are year-end full-issued capitalization shares, not free-float weights at the October peak. PetroChina entered in November 2007. Do not project this membership back onto the pre-peak period.

observations.statement: SSE's review states overall listed-company performance grew 47.5% and weighted EPS reached CNY 0.42.
observations.source_locator: Article dated 2008-06-02, opening paragraph; reports disclosed by 2008-04-30
observations.availability_note: Exact original public availability timestamp is not established. Publication date is separate metadata, not an intraday availability timestamp.
observations.interpretation_caveat: The source labels 47.5% as overall performance, not a same-constituent point-in-time index EPS growth series. Realized 2007 annual performance released in 2008 cannot validate what investors knew at the 2007 peak. Global first-place ranking remains unverified.

observations.statement: The 2007 new accounting standards changed opening equity and introduced a fair-value change line in reported earnings.
observations.source_locator: Second substantive paragraph on new accounting standards
observations.availability_note: Exact original public availability timestamp is not established. Publication date is separate metadata, not an intraday availability timestamp.
observations.interpretation_caveat: The 2.6% line alone does not measure all investment-related gains or all accounting comparability effects. Adjustments need an explicit reconciliation; no silent restatement.

observations.statement: China's goods exports and industrial profits expanded strongly in 2007, supporting the real-economy boom hypothesis.
observations.source_locator: Foreign Economic Relations / Table 6; Industrial and Construction / Table 3
observations.availability_note: Exact original public availability timestamp is not established. Publication date is separate metadata, not an intraday availability timestamp.
observations.interpretation_caveat: Industrial profits cover designated-size enterprises and only January-November, not the listed index or full calendar-year earnings. All figures belong to the February 2008 vintage.

observations.statement: The February 2008 statistical communique initially reported 2007 real GDP growth of 11.4%.
observations.source_locator: General Outlook, opening GDP paragraph
observations.availability_note: Exact original public availability timestamp is not established. Publication date is separate metadata, not an intraday availability timestamp.
observations.interpretation_caveat: Subsequently revised GDP histories must be stored as separate vintages. Do not silently substitute later revisions in an ex ante reconstruction.

observations.statement: WTO ranks China second in 2007 merchandise exports after Germany; China moved ahead of the United States.
observations.source_locator: Press/520/Rev.1; ranking discussion and Appendix leading merchandise exporters
observations.availability_note: Exact original public availability timestamp is not established. Publication date is separate metadata, not an intraday availability timestamp.
observations.interpretation_caveat: Export rank is not earnings-growth rank, manufacturing value-added rank, or stock-return rank. PDF is dated April 17, 2008; the HTML and PDF are this revised release vintage.

observations.statement: The nontradable share reform began in April 2005; by April 2006 almost 900 of approximately 1350 companies, representing 70% of capitalization, had completed it.
observations.source_locator: Equity market box / non-tradable share reform discussion
observations.availability_note: Exact original public availability timestamp is not established. Publication date is separate metadata, not an intraday availability timestamp.
observations.interpretation_caveat: This supports government-led market institution reform; it does not prove an official promise to prevent price declines or an instruction for every household to buy.

observations.statement: An IMF September 2007 analysis describes export integration, investment incentives and low capital cost as multi-year drivers of China becoming a world workshop.
observations.source_locator: How it began / Why is investment high?
observations.availability_note: Exact original public availability timestamp is not established. Publication date is separate metadata, not an intraday availability timestamp.
observations.interpretation_caveat: A policy-and-finance mechanism extending over years, not a megatrend first appearing in 2007. The document is an IMF staff analysis, not proof that 2007 China led global listed-company earnings growth.

observations.statement: PBC records six benchmark rate increases and ten reserve-requirement increases in 2007, with reserve ratios rising by 5.5 percentage points.
observations.source_locator: PDF pages 2 and 14 (1-based), Executive Summary and printed page 9
observations.availability_note: Exact original public availability timestamp is not established. Publication date is separate metadata, not an intraday availability timestamp.
observations.interpretation_caveat: Historical policy action chronology is available in Appendix 1. The annual narrative is dated February 22, 2008. Monetary policy addressed inflation/liquidity; a direct stock-price causal effect is a separate hypothesis.

observations.statement: The May 30, 2007 MOF/SAT notice imposed securities stamp duty at 3 per mille on each counterparty to A/B share transfers.
observations.source_locator: Caishui [2007] 84, stated issuance/effective date May 30; MOFCOM repost July 4
observations.availability_note: Exact original public availability timestamp is not established. Publication date is separate metadata, not an intraday availability timestamp.
observations.interpretation_caveat: Original notice date and repost date are distinct. This notice establishes the new rate; the prior 1-per-mille rate is not independently established by this archived notice alone.

observations.statement: MOF's fiscal-revenue analysis explicitly confirms the May 30, 2007 stamp duty increase from 1 per mille to 3 per mille, charged to both sides.
observations.source_locator: Section 7, securities transaction stamp tax; footer states publication date March 5, 2008
observations.availability_note: Exact original public availability timestamp is not established. Publication date is separate metadata, not an intraday availability timestamp.
observations.interpretation_caveat: Retrospective corroboration of the prior rate. URL includes August 2008 migration date; the visible footer publication date is March 5, 2008.

observations.statement: CSRC's January 8, 2010 notice announces approval in principle of margin-trading pilot and stock-index futures.
observations.source_locator: Article body on State Council approval
observations.availability_note: Exact original public availability timestamp is not established. Publication date is separate metadata, not an intraday availability timestamp.
observations.interpretation_caveat: 2007 should not be analyzed using the 2015 official margin-financing mechanism or current Korean margin balances without recognizing different market structures. This notice does not exclude every possible informal leverage channel in 2007.
